data.question_intent: Future trend of spread point and book dynamic
data.question_quote: Just on that spread point, the slight tailwind you're feeling from the back book, front book dynamic, can you just confirm that trend continues into 2025? That's not just a 2024 thing. That's from here on if pricing stays around current levels?
data.answer_quote: I would say assume it is going to be broadly neutral over time. I mean what we experienced last year was a position where you had Covid period loans rolling off and they were on higher margins. So throughout 2023, there was a big difference between those front book and back book margins. Now they're more aligned. And then what you've seen is a broad stabilisation in margins since that point. I don't think we're anticipating any massive change in what we see right now.
